must_identify.item: The api Service has no endpoints
must_identify.evidence: All running api pods carry only the label app=api [8, 9], so the Service matched zero pods, leaving endpoints/api empty [6].

must_identify.item: Its selector (app=api-v2) does not match the pod labels (app=api)
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a selector mismatch on the api Service: its live spec.selector was set to app: api-v2, while the Service's own last-applied-configuration annotation (the originally intended manifest) specifies app: api [7]. All running api pods carry only the label app=api [8, 9]

notes: The fix appears only indirectly, in 'Not Checked' as 'patching the Service selector'. Restoring app: api is implied by the reference to the last-applied annotation, so a reviewer may want to confirm this counts as an explicit fix recommendation. The claim that a first /api/items request succeeded is unusual but does not affect the diagnosis.
